source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Locate the failed test specifications on the materials data sheet.
3. If a parameter you wish to report doesn't appear on the material data sheet, then perform the requisite reference test(s) in order to determine the needed specification.
4. If a test that has failed an advertised specification has been conducted in a different manner than prescribed on the materials data sheet, then perform the requisite reference test in accordance with the methods that are prescribed on the materials data sheet in order to determine the difference between the actual test results and the advertised claim for the test specifications.


# Notes

There's no way to tell if two specifications are supposed to be quantified in the same terms or compared by the same method, unless one of the specifications is explicitly quantified on the material data sheet.
